rationale: No supported optimization is safely applicable. The main dependency-download cache (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) is already present in format-lint-lwc-tests, keyed on package-lock.json via actions/cache@v6, so the contraindication 'an equivalent cache already exists' applies and no new cache is needed. The timeout-based patterns (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT, P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT) require representative successful-duration history, but the repository CI history contains only a single failed run, so that precondition is not met; moreover the scratch-org-test job performs scratch-org creation, deployment, and Apex tests, which are valid slow runs that could exceed an arbitrary custom timeout (contraindication). Matrix-based patterns (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST) do not apply because there is no matrix. Path-filtering (P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER) has limited reported impact and required-status semantics must be preserved. Cancel-stale/skip-workflow/failed-job-first/build-priority/build-select are ci_service-scope or not applicable to this workflow's required checks. Bazel patterns are not applicable (no Bazel). Test selection/prioritization and smell/unused-output patterns are build_configuration or secondary-only with no concrete, verified issue in this workflow.
